title: Tribulus terrestris cream for medicinal use
intro: Tribulus terrestris cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the dried fruits of the Tribulus terrestris plant, commonly known as puncture vine. This cream is used in herbalism to support skin health and may help with conditions like eczema, psoriasis, and minor skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. It is often applied directly to the affected area to soothe inflammation and promote healing. The active compounds in Tribulus terrestris, such as saponins, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects. This preparation is valued in traditional medicine for its natural approach to addressing skin-related ailments.
